item.title: Designing a Cloud Storage Platform at Scale

item.description: Production-grade system design for a global fleet of 500,000 IoT vending machines — edge-offline operation, PCI-DSS payment isolation, MQTT telemetry ingestion, Kafka streaming, and TimescaleDB time-series analytics.
